title: customers.preferences-changed.v1
description: A customer's communication preference was recorded or replaced. The payload carries no preference — channels, language and quiet hours are Personal under data-classification.md section 5.3, whose consumer 'reads it through IConsentQuery and never copies it', and an outbox row is a copy. The event says the answer changed; the reader asks ICommunicationPreferenceQuery what it now is.

eventId.description: Identity of this occurrence. Delivery is at least once; consumers de-duplicate on it.

occurredAt.description: When the preference was recorded or replaced, in UTC.

aggregateId.description: The customer. Ordering is preserved per aggregate, so two changes cannot be seen out of order.

organisationId.description: The organisation the customer belongs to.

wasFirstRecorded.description: True when nobody had recorded a preference for this customer before. A fact about the system's knowledge rather than about her: the difference between a consumer that had nothing cached and one whose cache is now stale.

schemaVersion.description: The payload's major version. Agrees with the .v suffix of eventType.
